title: DatetimeOptions
description: Represents additional options for correct interpretation of datetime parameters used in the Amazon S3 path of a dataset.

allOf.description: Required option, that defines the datetime format used for a date parameter in the Amazon S3 path. Should use only supported datetime specifiers and separation characters, all literal a-z or A-Z characters should be escaped with single quotes. E.g. "MM.dd.yyyy-'at'-HH:mm".

Optional value for a timezone offset of the datetime parameter value in the Amazon S3 path. Shouldn't be used if Format for this parameter includes timezone fields. If no offset specified, UTC is assumed.
Optional value for a non-US locale code, needed for correct interpretation of some date formats.
